headline.bm: Trump tiba di China dan disambut Xi menjelang sidang kemuncak Trump–Xi–Putin Khamis, manakala serangan AS–Iran di sekitar Hormuz meluas dengan tiga kapal pengangkut pesawat AS di rantau itu. CISA menandakan kelemahan kritikal Puppet yang dieksploitasi aktif, peralihan Menteri Besar Negeri Sembilan berterusan, dan IPO Anthropic dijadual bermula 19 Nov. Kemas kini lewat: niaga hadapan saham AS naik pada 18 Nov selepas keputusan Nvidia, dan Umno mengecam kebocoran minit pengampunan Najib.
headline.en: Trump landed in China and was met by Xi ahead of Thursday's Trump–Xi–Putin summit, while US–Iran strikes widened around Hormuz with three US carriers in the region. CISA flagged an actively exploited critical Puppet flaw, Malaysia's Negeri Sembilan MB transition continues, and Anthropic's IPO debut is due 19 Nov. Late update: US stock futures rose on 18 Nov after Nvidia's results, and Umno has hit back over the leaked Najib pardon minutes.

summary.bm: Ekonomi Malaysia berkembang 5.5% pada suku ketiga, perlahan berbanding 6.0% setahun lalu tetapi melebihi anggaran awal 5.3%, dengan laporan menyebut pelaburan, eksport, permintaan berkaitan AI dan pelancongan.
summary.en: Malaysia's economy expanded 5.5% in the third quarter, eased from 6.0% a year earlier but above the 5.3% advance estimate, with reports citing investment, exports, AI-related demand and tourism.

title.bm: KDNK suku ketiga Malaysia berkembang 5.5%, melepasi anggaran awal 5.3%, didorong pelaburan dan eksport
title.en: Malaysia's Q3 GDP grows 5.5%, beating the 5.3% advance estimate, on investment and exports

why.bm: Pertumbuhan stabil menyokong pekerjaan dan ringgit, namun risiko luar daripada perang Iran dan harga minyak kekal.
why.en: Steady growth supports jobs and the ringgit, though external risks from the Iran war and oil remain.

summary.bm: Setiausaha Agung BN Zambry berkata pada 16 Nov Ismail menyerahkan surat peletakan jawatan kepada Tuanku Muhriz; istana belum mengesahkannya, dan Pengerusi Umno Negeri Sembilan Jalaluddin Alias berkata Umno negeri mengetahuinya melalui pucuk pimpinan. Zahid berkata seorang calon pengganti telah dikemukakan untuk perkenan diraja. Pada 18 Nov, Setiausaha Agung BN Zambry menggesa semua pihak membiarkan proses berjalan dan berharap kemelut diselesaikan dengan baik.
summary.en: BN secretary-general Zambry said on 16 Nov that Ismail submitted a resignation letter to Tuanku Muhriz; the palace had not verified it, and Umno Negeri Sembilan chief Jalaluddin Alias said the state party learned of it via national leadership. Zahid said one successor candidate has been submitted for royal consent. On 18 Nov BN secretary-general Zambry urged all sides to let the process run and hoped the deadlock is settled amicably.

title.bm: Menteri Besar Negeri Sembilan Ismail Lasim letak jawatan; Istana kata perkenan diraja masih diperlukan
title.en: Negeri Sembilan MB Ismail Lasim resigns; Palace says royal assent still needed

why.bm: Perubahan kepimpinan negeri dan ketidakpastian Bajet boleh menjejaskan dasar negeri serta imbangan kerajaan perpaduan.
why.en: A change of state leadership and Budget uncertainty could affect state policy and the wider unity-government balance.

summary.bm: Presiden Indonesia Prabowo memohon maaf kepada Singapura dan Malaysia berhubung jerebu rentas sempadan; ruangan Sinar Harian menyatakan maaf itu masih belum memadai. Butiran tindakan susulan tiada dalam sumber yang dibaca.
summary.en: Indonesian President Prabowo apologised to Singapore and Malaysia over cross-border haze; a Sinar Harian column says the apology is not yet enough. Details of follow-up action were not in the source read.

title.bm: Prabowo memohon maaf kepada Malaysia dan Singapura berhubung jerebu rentas sempadan
title.en: Prabowo apologises to Malaysia and Singapore over cross-border haze

why.bm: Jerebu menjejaskan kualiti udara, kesihatan dan sekolah, jadi rakyat Malaysia menantikan penguatkuasaan konkrit.
why.en: Haze affects air quality, health and schools, so Malaysians will look for concrete enforcement.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan Menteri Azalina menuntut penjelasan selepas minit Lembaga Pengampunan berhubung Najib Razak bocor. Butiran pihak yang perlu menjawab tidak tersedia daripada tajuk berita. Umno kemudian mengecam kebocoran itu sebagai 'provokasi' dan menyebut nama Tony Pua.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports Minister Azalina has demanded an explanation after minutes of the Pardons Board on Najib Razak were leaked. Details of who must respond were not available from the headline. Umno has since denounced the leak as a 'provocation' and singled out DAP's Tony Pua.

title.bm: Azalina minta penjelasan berhubung minit Lembaga Pengampunan Najib yang bocor
title.en: Azalina demands explanation over leaked Najib Pardons Board minutes

why.bm: Menyentuh integriti institusi rahsia negara dan kes berprofil tinggi.
why.en: Touches on the integrity of confidential national institutions and a high-profile case.

summary.bm: Anwar mengetuai delegasi Malaysia ke Minggu Pemimpin Ekonomi APEC pada 18 hingga 20 November. Beliau dijadual bertemu Presiden Xi di sebalik sidang itu.
summary.en: Anwar leads Malaysia's delegation to APEC Economic Leaders' Week from 18 to 20 November. He is scheduled to meet President Xi on the sidelines.

title.bm: Anwar tiba di Shenzhen untuk Minggu Pemimpin Ekonomi APEC dan dijadual bertemu Xi Jinping
title.en: Anwar arrives in Shenzhen for APEC Leaders' Week and is scheduled to meet Xi Jinping

why.bm: Menunjukkan keseimbangan hubungan Malaysia dengan China dan AS menjelang pertemuan Trump–Xi–Putin.
why.en: Shows how Malaysia balances ties with China and the US as the Trump–Xi–Putin meeting looms.

summary.bm: Macron dan Anwar mengumumkan peningkatan itu pada 17 Nov, bersama perjanjian helikopter penyelamat Airbus, pusat menangani ancaman hibrid dan projek nadir bumi Carester–Malaco Mining yang dijangka bermula awal 2027. Lebih 300 syarikat Perancis beroperasi di Malaysia.
summary.en: Macron and Anwar announced the upgrade on 17 Nov, with Airbus rescue helicopter agreements, a centre against hybrid threats and a Carester–Malaco Mining rare earths project due to start in early 2027. More than 300 French firms operate in Malaysia.

title.bm: Malaysia dan Perancis tingkatkan hubungan kepada perkongsian strategik semasa lawatan rasmi pertama Macron
title.en: Malaysia and France elevate ties to a strategic partnership during Macron's first official visit

why.bm: Perkongsian Strategik boleh memperdalam kerjasama pertahanan, pendidikan dan tenaga bersih dengan sebuah kuasa EU.
why.en: A Strategic Partnership could deepen defence, education and clean-energy links with an EU power.

summary.bm: Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim berkata tiada rombakan Kabinet dan Kabinet berfungsi dengan baik. Kenyataan itu susulan peletakan jawatan Menteri Pengangkutan Loke yang belum selesai serta gesaan pembubaran Parlimen awal.
summary.en: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said there will be no reshuffle and that the Cabinet is working well. The remark follows the pending resignation of Transport Minister Loke and calls for early dissolution of Parliament.

title.bm: Anwar: tiada rombakan Kabinet, kerajaan stabil
title.en: Anwar: no Cabinet reshuffle, government stable

why.bm: Memberi isyarat kestabilan politik persekutuan selepas minggu yang bergolak.
why.en: Signals federal political stability after a turbulent week.

summary.bm: Dalam kenyataan yang dibacakan Menteri Luar Mohamad Hasan pada Sidang Kemuncak Asia Timur ke-21, Anwar memberi amaran serangan berasaskan AI boleh melumpuhkan infrastruktur kritikal rentas sempadan. Beliau turut menyentuh rantaian bekalan, keselamatan tenaga dan makanan, Myanmar serta Gaza.
summary.en: In a statement read by Foreign Minister Mohamad Hasan at the 21st East Asia Summit, Anwar warned AI-enabled attacks could cripple critical cross-border infrastructure. He also raised supply chains, energy and food security, Myanmar and Gaza.

title.bm: Anwar gesa Sidang Kemuncak Asia Timur tangani serangan siber berasaskan AI
title.en: Anwar urges East Asia Summit to counter AI-enabled cyberattacks

why.bm: Menunjukkan pertahanan siber semakin penting dalam agenda serantau, relevan untuk pengendali rangkaian dan infrastruktur.
why.en: Signals cyber defence is moving up the regional agenda, relevant to network and infrastructure operators.

summary.bm: Dolar mencecah puncak 19 bulan baharu kerana jangkaan pengetatan Fed, dan saham jatuh selepas sekatan cip AI baharu AS terhadap China. Kuprum LME tiga bulan turun 0.4% kepada $13,210 satu tan, terendah lebih empat bulan.
summary.en: The dollar hit a fresh 19-month peak on bets of Fed tightening, and stocks fell after new US AI-chip curbs on China. Three-month LME copper fell 0.4% to $13,210 a tonne, its lowest in over four months.

title.bm: Dolar cecah paras tertinggi 19 bulan atas jangkaan Fed ketatkan dasar; kuprum terendah empat bulan
title.en: Dollar hits fresh 19-month high on Fed tightening bets; copper at four-month low

why.bm: Dolar kukuh menekan ringgit dan kos import.
why.en: A strong dollar pressures the ringgit and import costs.

summary.bm: Brent naik kira-kira 1% kepada $93.33 dan WTI $86.53 pada Selasa selepas serangan dron Iran dan sebuah kapal tangki terkena di Hormuz; Brent turun 20% dan WTI 16% bulan ini. IEA berkata Jumaat lalu pasaran minyak akan kembali lebih bekalan pada suku keempat.
summary.en: Brent rose about 1% to $93.33 and WTI to $86.53 on Tuesday after Iranian drone attacks and a tanker hit in Hormuz; Brent is down 20% and WTI 16% this month. The IEA said last Friday the oil market will return to surplus in Q4.

title.bm: Minyak naik sedikit kerana serangan kapal tangki; Brent masih jatuh 20% bulan ini
title.en: Oil edges up on tanker attacks; Brent still down 20% this month

why.bm: Minyak lebih rendah berbanding kemuncak April meredakan tekanan subsidi bahan api, tetapi risiko Hormuz kekal.
why.en: Lower oil than April's peak eases pressure on fuel subsidies, but Hormuz risk remains.

summary.bm: Seorang pegawai kanan PBB menggesa kargo baja dibenarkan melalui Hormuz; harga baja naik 30% sejak sekatan bermula dan kegagalan menanam boleh menyebabkan 45 juta orang berdepan kekurangan makanan teruk. Tentera laut Iran berkata tujuh kapal tangki terkena periuk api dalam 24 jam dan mengaitkan pembukaan semula dengan penamatan sekatan AS.
summary.en: A senior UN official urged fertiliser cargoes be allowed through Hormuz; fertiliser prices are up 30% since the blockades began and missed planting could leave 45 million people facing severe food insecurity. Iran's navy says seven tankers hit mines within 24 hours and ties reopening to an end to the US blockade.

title.bm: PBB gesa koridor Hormuz terhad masa untuk kapal baja apabila harga naik 30%
title.en: UN urges time-bound Hormuz corridor for fertiliser ships as prices rise 30%

why.bm: Baja lebih mahal boleh menaikkan kos makanan dan input kelapa sawit di Asia, termasuk Malaysia.
why.en: Costlier fertiliser can push up food and palm oil input costs across Asia, including Malaysia.

summary.bm: Hasil Perbendaharaan 10 tahun naik ke sekitar 5.15% (naik kira-kira 30 mata asas seminggu) dan indeks dolar ke 103.41, tertinggi sejak April 2025. Niaga hadapan sepenuhnya menjangka kenaikan kadar pada FOMC 8-9 Dis.
summary.en: The 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 5.15% (up roughly 30bp on the week) and the dollar index to 103.41, its highest since April 2025. Futures fully price a rate hike at the 8-9 Dec FOMC.

title.bm: Dolar hampir paras tertinggi 19 bulan apabila pedagang meramal kenaikan kadar Fed; hasil 10 tahun 5.14%
title.en: Dollar near 19-month high as traders price possible Fed hike; 10-year yield at 5.14%

why.bm: Dolar lebih kukuh dan hasil lebih tinggi menekan ringgit dan Bursa serta menaikkan kos import.
why.en: A stronger dollar and higher yields weigh on the ringgit and Bursa and raise import costs.

summary.bm: S&P 500 ditutup 7,561.67 (-0.40%) dan Nasdaq jatuh 0.91%; AMD merosot 8.75% dan Nvidia 2% selepas peletakan jawatan CEOnya dan penurunan taraf. Seminggu, S&P naik 2.51%, Dow 2.07% dan Nasdaq 2.27%.
summary.en: The S&P 500 closed at 7,561.67 (-0.40%) and the Nasdaq fell 0.91%; AMD dropped 8.75% and Nvidia 2% after its CEO's resignation and a downgrade. For the week the S&P rose 2.51%, the Dow 2.07% and the Nasdaq 2.27%.

title.bm: Wall Street ditutup lebih rendah Jumaat akibat jualan cip, tetapi S&P 500 naik 2.5% seminggu
title.en: Wall Street ends Friday lower on chip selloff, but S&P 500 gains 2.5% on the week

why.bm: Kegoyahan sektor cip memberi kesan kepada saham teknologi Asia dan semikonduktor Malaysia.
why.en: Chip-sector volatility feeds into Asian tech and Malaysian semiconductor shares.

summary.bm: Pertumbuhan tahunan 1.9%. Timbalan Gabenor BoE Lombardelli berkata kejutan tenaga lebih lama daripada dijangka, menguatkan hujah kenaikan kadar lagi; sidang kemuncak UK-EU dijadual 20 Nov.
summary.en: Annual growth was 1.9%. BoE Deputy Governor Lombardelli said the energy shock has lasted longer than expected, strengthening the case for more hikes; a UK-EU summit is set for 20 Nov.

title.bm: KDNK UK suku ketiga naik 0.7%, terkukuh dalam lebih dua tahun, BoE beri amaran kejutan tenaga berpanjangan
title.en: UK Q3 GDP grows 0.7%, strongest in over two years, as BoE warns energy shock lasts longer

why.bm: Kadar tinggi lebih lama di ekonomi utama mengekalkan pembiayaan global ketat.
why.en: Higher-for-longer rates in major economies keep global financing tight.

summary.bm: Beijing mengecam penggunaan dakwaan "pengintipan" Nvidia oleh AS untuk mempertahankan sekatan teknologi, merumitkan pertemuan Xi-Trump minggu depan. Gencatan setahun itu tamat pada Januari. Senator Demokrat meminta rekod eksport Nvidia dipelihara.
summary.en: Beijing denounced US use of Nvidia "spying" claims to defend tech curbs, complicating next week's Xi-Trump meeting. The year-long truce expires in January. Democratic senators asked the administration to preserve Nvidia export records.

title.bm: Pertikaian Nvidia menguji gencatan dagang AS-China menjelang kunjungan Trump ke Xi minggu depan
title.en: Nvidia row tests US-China trade truce as Xi set to welcome Trump next week

why.bm: Kegagalan rundingan boleh menjejaskan rantaian bekalan cip dan sektor semikonduktor Malaysia yang bergantung pada eksport.
why.en: A breakdown would hit chip supply chains and Malaysia's export-driven semiconductor sector.

summary.bm: Setakat 15 Nov (data hingga 14 Nov), ECDC menyatakan DRC mencatat 11,376 kes disahkan dan 5,568 kematian di lapan wilayah, Ituri paling teruk dan penularan komuniti berterusan. Tiada vaksin berlesen atau rawatan khusus; ECDC menilai risiko sangat rendah kepada penduduk umum EU/EEA.
summary.en: As of 15 Nov (data to 14 Nov), ECDC says DRC has 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 related deaths across eight provinces, with Ituri worst hit and community transmission ongoing. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; ECDC rates risk very low for the general EU/EEA population.

title.bm: Ebola (Bundibugyo): DRC rekod 11,376 kes disahkan dan 5,568 kematian
title.en: Ebola (Bundibugyo): DRC reports 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths

why.bm: WHO tidak menggalakkan larangan perjalanan; elakkan bersentuhan dengan pesakit dan dapatkan rawatan jika demam selepas pulang dari kawasan terjejas.
why.en: WHO advises against travel bans; avoid contact with the sick and seek care for fever after travel to affected areas.

summary.bm: Laporan yang memetik Wall Street Journal menyatakan AS hilang status penghapusan campak selepas penularan berterusan; ABC melaporkan kes seluruh negara melebihi 5,400 dengan 10 kematian. CDC merekodkan 5,412 kes disahkan setakat 13 Nov, naik 230 seminggu.
summary.en: Reports citing the Wall Street Journal say the US lost its measles elimination status after continued spread; ABC reports nationwide cases above 5,400 with 10 deaths. The CDC counted 5,412 confirmed cases by 13 Nov, up 230 in a week.

title.bm: AS dilaporkan hilang status penghapusan campak apabila kes melebihi 5,400
title.en: US reported to lose measles elimination status as cases top 5,400

why.bm: Semak vaksin MMR anak sebelum melancong ke AS.
why.en: Check children's MMR vaccination before travelling to the US.

summary.bm: Gardenia Malaysia Timur menjelaskan ia entiti berasingan daripada Gardenia KL selepas aduan membabitkan Original Classic White Bread dan Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. KKM menunggu keputusan makmal dan akan memeriksa kilang KL di bawah Akta Makanan 1983; nombor kelompok belum lengkap.
summary.en: Gardenia East Malaysia says it is separate from Gardenia KL after complaints involving Original Classic White Bread and Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. The Health Ministry awaits lab results and will inspect the KL factory under the Food Act 1983; batch numbers are incomplete.

title.bm: Malaysia: KKM siasat dakwaan sakit selepas makan produk Gardenia
title.en: Malaysia: KKM probes illness claims linked to Gardenia bread and snacks

why.bm: Nota keselamatan: simpan bungkusan dan lapor gejala kepada KKM; tiada penarikan balik diumumkan.
why.en: Safety note: keep the packaging and report symptoms to KKM; no recall announced.

summary.bm: Dua kes disahkan klade 1 dan dua lagi disyaki menunggu analisis; tiga pesakit berkata mereka tidak keluar dari daerah itu setahun lalu. Klade 1 mempunyai kadar kematian dilaporkan 1% hingga 10%, berbanding 1% hingga 4% bagi klade 2.
summary.en: Two cases are confirmed clade 1 and two are suspected pending analysis; three patients say they did not leave the county in the past year. Clade 1 has a reported fatality rate of 1% to 10%, versus 1% to 4% for clade 2.

title.bm: California siasat empat kes mpox klade 1 di Stanislaus County, tiga tanpa sejarah perjalanan
title.en: California investigates four clade 1 mpox cases in Stanislaus County, three with no travel

why.bm: Penularan tempatan menunjukkan jangkitan tidak dikesan; elak sentuhan rapat dengan orang berruam dan dapatkan rawatan awal jika bergejala.
why.en: Local spread suggests undetected transmission; avoid close contact with anyone with a rash and seek care early if symptoms appear.

summary.bm: CBS melaporkan AS menyerang tapak peluru berpandu IRGC di Pulau Qeshm pada Selasa 17 Nov dalam tindakan yang disifatkan pegawai AS sebagai mempertahankan diri, selepas percubaan ketiga serangan dron Iran ke atas tapak radar AS di Bahrain dalam tempoh kurang seminggu (semua dipintas, kata CENTCOM). Iran menegaskan Hormuz ditutup tanpa penyelarasan; sebuah kapal tangki terkena berhampiran Khasab, Oman, dan tentera laut Iran berkata satu lagi terlanggar periuk api.
summary.en: CBS reports the US hit an IRGC missile site on Qeshm Island on Tuesday 17 Nov in what a US official called self-defence, after Iran's third attempted drone attack on a US radar site in Bahrain in under a week (all intercepted, per CENTCOM). Iran says Hormuz is closed without coordination; a tanker was hit near Khasab, Oman, and Iran's navy said another struck a mine.

title.bm: Pesawat AS serang tapak pelancaran peluru berpandu IRGC di Pulau Qeshm, dakwa pertahanan diri
title.en: US aircraft strike IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island, citing self-defence

why.bm: Peningkatan ketegangan menaikkan kos minyak, perkapalan dan baja yang mempengaruhi harga bahan api dan makanan Malaysia.
why.en: Escalation raises oil, shipping and fertiliser costs that feed into Malaysian fuel and food prices.

summary.bm: CNN melaporkan Xi bertemu Trump sebaik beliau tiba di China, satu protokol luar biasa bagi pemimpin yang berkunjung, ketika Minggu Pemimpin APEC dibuka di Shenzhen. Putin sudah berada di Shenzhen dan sidang kemuncak pertama Trump–Xi–Putin dijadual 19 Nov, dengan perang Iran dan senjata nuklear dalam agenda.
summary.en: CNN reports Xi met Trump on his arrival in China, unusual protocol for a visiting leader, as APEC Leaders' Week opens in Shenzhen. Putin is already in Shenzhen and the first Trump–Xi–Putin summit is due on 19 Nov, with the Iran war and nuclear arms on the agenda.

title.bm: Trump tiba di China untuk APEC; Xi pecah protokol dengan bertemu beliau sebaik tiba, menjelang sidang kemuncak tiga hala bersama Putin Khamis
title.en: Trump lands in China for APEC; Xi breaks precedent by meeting him on arrival, ahead of Thursday's three-way summit with Putin

why.bm: Pertemuan AS–China–Rusia membentuk perang Iran, gencatan perdagangan dan harga minyak yang memberi kesan kepada Malaysia; Anwar turut hadir di APEC.
why.en: A US–China–Russia meeting shapes the Iran war, trade truce and oil prices that affect Malaysia, where Anwar also attends APEC.

summary.bm: Tentera laut Iran berkata kapal tangki minyak keempat terkena periuk api laut dan terbakar di timur Selat Hormuz, menambah dakwaan terdahulu mengenai kapal tangki terkena periuk api. Dakwaan ini datang daripada sumber tentera Iran dan belum disahkan secara bebas.
summary.en: Iran's army navy said a fourth oil tanker struck a naval mine and caught fire east of the Strait of Hormuz, adding to earlier claims of tankers hit by mines. The claims come from Iranian military sources and are not independently confirmed.

title.bm: Iran: kapal tangki keempat terkena periuk api dan terbakar di timur Hormuz
title.en: Iran says a fourth tanker hit a mine and caught fire east of Hormuz

why.bm: Serangan berulang terhadap perkapalan mengekalkan risiko harga minyak serta kos bahan api dan kargo Malaysia; dakwaan ini daripada sumber negara Iran.
why.en: Repeated hits on shipping keep oil prices and Malaysian fuel and freight costs exposed; claims come from Iranian state sources.

summary.bm: Zelenskiy berkata serangan itu balasan terhadap serangan Rusia ke atas infrastruktur Ukraine, dan Kyiv Independent melaporkan satu bahagian penuh jambatan runtuh. Rusia dilaporkan bergegas membaiki laluan itu, dan serangan berlaku pada malam kedua berturut-turut menurut ABC News.
summary.en: Zelenskiy said the strike was a response to Russian attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure, and Kyiv Independent reports an entire section of the bridge collapsed. Russia is reported to be scrambling to repair the link, and the strike came on a second consecutive night per ABC News.

title.bm: Ukraine dakwa satu bahagian jambatan Crimea runtuh selepas 'operasi tujuh fasa'
title.en: Ukraine says a section of the Crimea bridge collapsed after a 'seven-phase operation'

why.bm: Peningkatan ketegangan pada laluan logistik utama perang berlaku sebelum pertemuan Trump–Xi–Putin 19 Nov.
why.en: Escalation on the war's key logistics link comes just before the 19 Nov Trump–Xi–Putin meeting.

summary.bm: Putin mendarat di Shenzhen pada 17 Nov untuk APEC; pertemuan tiga hala pertama bersama Trump dan Xi dijadualkan Khamis 19 Nov. Trump berkata pada 16 Nov beliau akan membangkitkan perang Ukraine, berbeza daripada pendirian Rumah Putih pada 13 Nov, dan Kremlin berkata sebahagian pertemuan mungkin dibuka kepada media jika Beijing bersetuju.
summary.en: Putin landed in Shenzhen on 17 Nov for APEC; the first three-way meeting with Trump and Xi is set for Thursday 19 Nov. Trump said on 16 Nov he would raise the Ukraine war, reversing the White House's 13 Nov position, and the Kremlin says part of the meeting may be open to the press if Beijing agrees.

title.bm: Putin tiba di Shenzhen menjelang sidang kemuncak pertama Trump–Xi–Putin pada Khamis
title.en: Putin arrives in Shenzhen ahead of first Trump–Xi–Putin summit on Thursday

why.bm: Hasilnya mengenai Iran, Ukraine dan kawalan senjata akan menggerakkan minyak, pasaran dan perdagangan ASEAN; Anwar turut berada di Shenzhen.
why.en: Outcomes on Iran, Ukraine and arms control will move oil, markets and ASEAN trade; Anwar is also in Shenzhen.

summary.bm: Iran melepaskan dron ke sistem radar AS di pangkalan Sheikh Isa, Bahrain; Bahrain berkata serangan itu dipintas dan tiada korban atau kerosakan dilaporkan. Anak kapal sebuah kapal tangki dilaporkan hilang di Selat Hormuz utara Khasab, manakala rundingan Qatar–Iran dijadual di Doha dengan penglibatan Oman.
summary.en: Iran fired drones at a US radar system at Bahrain's Sheikh Isa base; Bahrain said it intercepted the attack with no casualties or damage reported. A tanker crew was reported missing in the Strait of Hormuz north of Khasab, while Qatar–Iran talks were set for Doha with Oman involved.

title.bm: Dron Iran serang radar AS di Bahrain walaupun rundingan pengantara; anak kapal tangki hilang berhampiran Hormuz
title.en: Iran drones hit at US radar in Bahrain despite mediation talks; tanker crew missing near Hormuz

why.bm: Peningkatan ketegangan semasa rundingan mengekalkan risiko harga minyak serta kos bahan api dan kargo Malaysia.
why.en: Escalation during talks keeps oil and Malaysian fuel and freight costs at risk.

summary.bm: Pada sidang ASEAN di Manila, Anwar menyeru komitmen politik baharu untuk memuktamadkan Tataamalan (COC) Laut China Selatan, menurut Bernama. Rundingan telah berlarutan bertahun-tahun.
summary.en: At the ASEAN summit in Manila, Anwar called for renewed political commitment to conclude the South China Sea Code of Conduct, per Bernama. Talks have dragged on for years.

title.bm: Anwar gesa komitmen politik baharu untuk muktamadkan COC Laut China Selatan
title.en: Anwar urges fresh political commitment to finalise South China Sea code of conduct

why.bm: Tataamalan mengikat dapat mengurangkan ketegangan maritim yang menjejaskan perairan dan laluan perdagangan Malaysia.
why.en: A binding code would lower maritime tension affecting Malaysian waters and trade routes.

summary.bm: Euronews melaporkan AS menyerang pelancar peluru berpandu di Bandar Lengeh dan Sirik pada 15 Nov, manakala IRGC berkata dua lagi kapal tangki meletup di Hormuz pada 16 Nov, menjadikan jumlahnya enam sejak Ahad (belum disahkan secara bebas). USS Theodore Roosevelt menyertai George Washington dan George H.W. Bush, dengan kira-kira 19 kapal perang AS dalam pengukuhan itu.
summary.en: Euronews reports the US struck missile launchers at Bandar Lengeh and Sirik on 15 Nov, while Iran's IRGC said two more tankers exploded in Hormuz on 16 Nov, taking its tally to six since Sunday (not independently confirmed). The USS Theodore Roosevelt joined the George Washington and George H.W. Bush, with about 19 US warships in the build-up.

title.bm: AS himpun tiga kapal pengangkut pesawat di Timur Tengah ketika serangan AS–Iran meluas; IRGC dakwa enam kapal tangki terkena sejak Ahad
title.en: US masses three carriers in the Middle East as US–Iran strikes widen; IRGC says six tankers hit since Sunday

why.bm: Perang AS–Iran yang lebih luas akan mengekalkan kos minyak, perkapalan dan baja yang tinggi untuk Malaysia.
why.en: A wider US–Iran war would keep oil, shipping and fertiliser costs high for Malaysia.

summary.bm: Julatnya $70-$78 sesaham, dan Gate News (memetik WSJ dan media lain) menyebut harga akhir mungkin melebihi $80 dengan penilaian $1.5-1.6 trilion; dagangan sebagai ANT di Nasdaq dijadual 19 Nov. Harga akhir belum disahkan dalam sumber yang ditemui.
summary.en: The range was $70-$78 a share, and Gate News (citing WSJ and other media) says the final price may exceed $80 with a valuation of $1.5-1.6 trillion; trading as ANT on Nasdaq is due 19 Nov. The final price was not confirmed in sources found.

title.bm: IPO Anthropic mengikut jadual: penetapan harga 18 Nov, mula didagangkan di Nasdaq 19 Nov sebagai 'ANT', dilaporkan lebih langganan sekitar 6 kali
title.en: Anthropic IPO on track: pricing 18 Nov, Nasdaq debut 19 Nov as 'ANT', reportedly about 6x oversubscribed

why.bm: Julat ini sebelum penetapan harga; semak semula 18-19 Nov.
why.en: The range is pre-pricing; re-check on Nov 18-19.

summary.bm: Gemini 4 Hydrogen tersedia dalam AI Studio, API Gemini, aplikasi Gemini dan Carian, berharga $1.50 sejuta token input dan $7.50 sejuta token output dengan konteks 1 juta token. Google mendakwa ia hampir setara Carbon pada Terminal-Bench 4.0 dengan penggunaan kuota 24% lebih rendah (angka syarikat).
summary.en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen is available in AI Studio, the Gemini API, the Gemini app and Search, priced at $1.50 per million input and $7.50 per million output tokens with a 1M-token context. Google says it nears Carbon on Terminal-Bench 4.0 with 24% less quota use (company figures).

title.bm: Google lancarkan Gemini 4 Hydrogen merentasi API, aplikasi dan Carian
title.en: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen across API, app and Search

why.bm: Peringkat Gemini yang lebih murah meningkatkan tekanan harga ke atas API AI pesaing.
why.en: A cheaper Gemini tier raises price pressure on rival AI APIs.

summary.bm: Pelancaran terhad kepada pengguna ChatGPT Pro AS berumur 18+ dengan kad AS; pembelian ditokenkan dan memerlukan kelulusan Face ID atau cap jari. Had perbelanjaan dirancang tetapi belum aktif.
summary.en: Rollout is limited to US ChatGPT Pro users aged 18+ with US cards; purchases are tokenised and need Face ID or fingerprint approval. Spending limits are planned but not yet live.

title.bm: ChatGPT Wallet dilancarkan supaya ejen AI boleh membeli-belah dan membayar
title.en: ChatGPT Wallet launches so AI agents can shop and check out

why.bm: Belum tersedia di Malaysia; tunggu had perbelanjaan.
why.en: Not available in Malaysia for now; wait for spending limits.

summary.bm: Diumumkan pada acara Cyber at the Frontier, Red Team menggunakan agen AI untuk ujian penembusan aplikasi web dan mengesahkan kelemahan, manakala Defense Factory menyiasat dapatan dan merangka tampalan untuk semakan manusia. Tiada yang dikerahkan secara automatik.
summary.en: Announced at its Cyber at the Frontier event, Red Team uses AI agents to pentest web apps and confirm vulnerabilities, while Defense Factory investigates findings and drafts patches for human review. Nothing is auto-deployed.

title.bm: OpenAI dedahkan alat keselamatan Daybreak Red Team dan Defense Factory
title.en: OpenAI unveils Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory security tools

why.bm: Penampalan dibantu AI boleh memendekkan masa pembaikan untuk pasukan IT dan rangkaian.
why.en: AI-assisted patching could shorten fix times for IT and network teams.

summary.bm: Syarikat boleh menjalankan perkhidmatan agen dalam awan atau premis sendiri, dengan hanya panggilan model dihantar ke Anthropic atau rakan awan; akses melalui permohonan.
summary.en: Companies can run the agent service in their own cloud or on-premises, with only model calls going to Anthropic or a cloud partner; access is by request.

title.bm: Anthropic tawar Claude Managed Agents dihoskan sendiri dalam beta persendirian
title.en: Anthropic offers self-hosted Claude Managed Agents in private beta

why.bm: Membantu firma terkawal menyimpan data dalam organisasi ketika menggunakan agen AI.
why.en: Helps regulated firms keep data in-house when adopting AI agents.

summary.bm: Fable 5.2 ialah model asas sama dengan Mythos 5.2 dengan perlindungan siber dan biologi lebih kuat, berharga $8/$40 per juta token ($16/$80 mod pantas). Anthropic masih menyifatkan Claude Opus 5.5 pilihan harian terbaik.
summary.en: Fable 5.2 is the same underlying model as Mythos 5.2 with stronger cyber and biology safeguards, priced at $8/$40 per million tokens ($16/$80 in fast mode). Anthropic still calls Claude Opus 5.5 its best daily driver.

title.bm: Anthropic lancar Claude Fable 5.2 untuk semua pengguna; Mythos 5.2 terhad kepada organisasi disahkan
title.en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 to all users; Mythos 5.2 limited to vetted orgs

why.bm: Semak kos dan had penggunaan sebelum bertukar model.
why.en: Check cost and usage limits before switching models.

summary.bm: CISA menambah kelemahan deserialisasi itu ke KEV pada 17 Nov; ia menjejaskan Puppet Enterprise dan Puppet Core, serta OpenVox, dengan pembaikan dikeluarkan 3 Nov. Agensi AS mesti membaiki menjelang 1 Dis.
summary.en: CISA added the deserialization flaw to KEV on 17 Nov; it affects Puppet Enterprise and Puppet Core, plus OpenVox, with fixes released on 3 Nov. US agencies must remediate by 1 Dec.

title.bm: CISA tanda kelemahan RCE kritikal Puppet yang dieksploitasi aktif (CVE-2026-115731, CVSS 9.4)
title.en: CISA flags actively exploited critical Puppet RCE (CVE-2026-115731, CVSS 9.4)

why.bm: Kemas kini kepada PE 2026.0.1/2025.12.1/2023.8.13 atau Puppet Core 9.1.3/8.22.2; relevan untuk automasi rangkaian dan infrastruktur.
why.en: Patch to PE 2026.0.1/2025.12.1/2023.8.13 or Puppet Core 9.1.3/8.22.2; relevant to network and infrastructure automation.

summary.bm: Penulisan di luar sempadan dalam penyahkod Base64 boleh menyebabkan DoS atau RCE tanpa pengesahan pada Java 17.0.6+, 21, 25 dan 27 pada cip x86-64 AVX-512; aplikasi disebut termasuk Keycloak, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins dan Artifactory. Tiada eksploitasi di dunia nyata dilaporkan dan ia tiada dalam KEV.
summary.en: An out-of-bounds write in the Base64 decoder can cause DoS or unauthenticated RCE on Java 17.0.6+, 21, 25 and 27 on AVX-512 x86-64 chips; apps named include Keycloak, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins and Artifactory. No in-the-wild exploitation was reported and it is not in KEV.

title.bm: CISA gesa tampalan segera 'Java4Shell' (CVE-2026-114938) dalam JVM HotSpot x86-64
title.en: CISA urges immediate patching of 'Java4Shell' (CVE-2026-114938) in x86-64 HotSpot JVM

why.bm: Naik taraf ke Oracle 17.0.21.1/21.0.13.1/25.0.5.1/27.0.1.1 atau binaan vendor anda; penyelesaian sementara -XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics.
why.en: Upgrade to Oracle 17.0.21.1/21.0.13.1/25.0.5.1/27.0.1.1 or your vendor build; workaround -XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics.

summary.bm: Satu kunci yang dikeluarkan Cursor kepada Fireworks AI terdedah dalam pelanggaran Fireworks; penyerang menyalin data dari baldi kongsi dan pada 29 Okt menanam sambungan Claude Code berniat jahat pada cache yang melayani pasaran Cursor, berpotensi menjangkiti sehingga 5,000 pengguna.
summary.en: A key Cursor issued to Fireworks AI was exposed in a Fireworks breach; the attacker copied data from a shared bucket and on 29 Oct planted a trojanized Claude Code extension on the cache serving Cursor's marketplace, potentially reaching up to 5,000 users.

title.bm: Kunci Fireworks AI dicuri membawa kepada pelanggaran Cursor dan sambungan Claude Code berniat jahat
title.en: Stolen Fireworks AI key led to Cursor breach and a trojanized Claude Code extension

why.bm: Pembangun: semak sambungan IDE yang dipasang dan tukar mana-mana kunci yang terdedah.
why.en: Developers: review installed IDE extensions and rotate any exposed keys.

summary.bm: Tampalan kecemasan membaiki kelemahan tahap tinggi yang dieksploitasi sejak akhir Oktober untuk akses root dan kegigihan. Berasingan, get laluan Check Point yang terdedah diserang melalui PHP2Shell yang memasang perisian pemadam data pada hos VMware ESXi.
summary.en: Emergency hotfixes fix a high-severity flaw exploited since late October for root access and persistence. Separately, vulnerable Check Point gateways were hit with PHP2Shell attacks that dropped data-wiping malware on VMware ESXi hosts.

title.bm: Check Point tampal sifar-hari get laluan yang dieksploitasi; pemadam ESXi dipasang melalui PHP2Shell
title.en: Check Point patches exploited gateway zero-day; ESXi wiper deployed via PHP2Shell

why.bm: Pentadbir rangkaian: pasang hotfix Check Point sekarang dan semak log get laluan serta ESXi.
why.en: Network admins: apply the Check Point hotfix now and review gateway and ESXi logs.

summary.bm: Tahap dinaikkan daripada Rendah ke Sederhana pada 4 Nov berikutan ketegangan geopolitik dan pendedahan pusat data; infrastruktur kritikal mesti mematuhi sembilan langkah termasuk pemantauan 24 jam dan MFA. Fahmi berkata tiada insiden membimbangkan disahkan semasa PRN Melaka.
summary.en: The level moved from Low to Medium on 4 Nov citing geopolitical tension and data-centre exposure; critical infrastructure must follow nine measures including 24-hour monitoring and MFA. Fahmi said no worrying incidents were confirmed during the Melaka polls.

title.bm: NACSA amaran amber selepas menaikkan tahap ancaman siber negara ke Sederhana
title.en: NACSA on amber alert after raising national cyber threat level to Medium

why.bm: Syarikat: tampal peranti sempadan dan kuatkuasa MFA; orang ramai: rujuk NACSA untuk maklumat rasmi.
why.en: Firms: patch edge devices and enforce MFA; public: rely on NACSA for official updates.

summary.bm: Cult of Mac melaporkan Full Disk Access dipecahkan kepada Accessibility dan System & App Protection Override, dengan pilihan 'Ask First' atau 'At Any Time' bagi setiap aplikasi serta penunjuk bar menu. Perubahan hanya untuk permintaan kebenaran baharu dan masih beta.
summary.en: Cult of Mac reports Full Disk Access is split into Accessibility and System & App Protection Override, with per-app 'Ask First' or 'At Any Time' choices and a menu bar indicator. Changes apply to new permission requests only and it is still beta.

title.bm: macOS 27.3 beta 2 beri kawalan lebih terperinci terhadap akses ejen AI
title.en: macOS 27.3 beta 2 gives users finer control over what AI agents can access

why.bm: Membantu menghadkan apa yang ejen AI pada Mac boleh lakukan bagi pihak anda.
why.en: Helps limit what AI agents on a Mac can do on your behalf.

summary.bm: Notifikasi ancaman Apple 29 Okt dihantar kepada pengguna di 99 negara; menteri Thailand berkata amaran sahaja tidak membuktikan peranti dijejaskan dan tiada bukti kaitan dengan Pegasus. SecurityWeek turut menerangkan bagaimana Secure Exclaves Apple melindungi data kamera dan mikrofon.
summary.en: Apple's 29 Oct threat notifications went to users in 99 countries; Thailand's minister said alerts alone do not show a device was compromised and no evidence links it to Pegasus. SecurityWeek separately explained how Apple's Secure Exclaves protect camera and microphone data.

title.bm: Apple bertemu pegawai Thailand berhubung amaran perisian intip selepas notifikasi ancaman 29 Okt
title.en: Apple meets Thai officials over spyware alerts sent after its 29 Oct threat notifications

why.bm: Jika menerima amaran ancaman Apple, kemas kini iOS dan pertimbangkan Mod Lockdown.
why.en: If you receive an Apple threat alert, update iOS and consider Lockdown Mode.

summary.bm: Nasihat menyenaraikan kira-kira sembilan kelemahan dalam sembang kumpulan iMessage, pasangan Bluetooth dan AirPlay; Apple tidak menyatakan ada yang dieksploitasi.
summary.en: The advisory lists around nine vulnerabilities in iMessage group chat, Bluetooth pairing and AirPlay; Apple did not say any was exploited.

title.bm: Apple keluarkan pembaikan keselamatan iOS/macOS 27.2.1, serta iOS 26.7.3 dan 18.7.12 untuk peranti lama
title.en: Apple ships iOS/macOS 27.2.1 security fixes, plus iOS 26.7.3 and 18.7.12 for older devices

why.bm: Kemas kini melalui Settings > General > Software Update.
why.en: Update via Settings > General > Software Update.

summary.bm: Bermula iOS, iPadOS, macOS dan visionOS 27.3, fail dan foto yang dikongsi dengan 'sesiapa yang ada pautan' boleh diakses Apple untuk semakan, walaupun Advanced Data Protection dihidupkan. Pautan yang dikongsi hanya dengan individu tertentu dikecualikan, dan Apple boleh membuang kandungan atau melumpuhkan akaun, dengan keluaran awam dijangka pada Disember.
summary.en: From iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS 27.3, files and photos shared with 'Anyone with the link' become accessible to Apple for review, even with Advanced Data Protection on. Links shared only with named people are excluded, and Apple may remove content or disable accounts, with public release expected in December.

title.bm: Apple akan semak pautan iCloud awam untuk kandungan berbahaya mulai iOS 27.3, menamatkan penyulitan hujung ke hujung bagi pautan itu
title.en: Apple will review public iCloud links for harmful content from iOS 27.3, ending end-to-end encryption for them

why.bm: Jika anda berkongsi pautan iCloud secara awam, anggap ia tidak peribadi; kongsi dengan individu tertentu sebaliknya.
why.en: If you share iCloud links publicly, treat them as non-private; share with named people instead.

summary.bm: Android Police berkata sesetengah pengguna Pixel 11 Pro dan Pro XL melihat skrin hitam atau ralat pada aplikasi kamera, berdasarkan hantaran pengguna dan bukan kerosakan meluas yang disahkan. Google belum mengeluarkan pembaikan rasmi; mematikan telefon 1–2 minit membantu sekurang-kurangnya seorang pengguna.
summary.en: Android Police says some Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL users see a black screen or error in the camera app, based on user posts rather than a confirmed widespread fault. Google has not issued an official fix; powering off for 1–2 minutes helped at least one user.

title.bm: Pemilik Pixel lapor pepijat kamera dan lain-lain selepas kemas kini Android 17 November
title.en: Pixel owners report camera and other bugs after the Android 17 November update

why.bm: Jika terjejas, mulakan semula dan tunggu pembaikan Google.
why.en: If affected, restart and watch for Google's fix before rolling back.

summary.bm: Skrin belakang menyokong apl Google, Spotify dan apl GenAI buatan pengguna, menurut 9to5Google.
summary.en: The rear displays support Google apps, Spotify and user-built GenAI apps, according to 9to5Google.

title.bm: Skrin belakang Xiaomi 18 Pro dan Pro Max boleh jalankan Google Maps, YouTube Music, Spotify dan apl GenAI tersuai
title.en: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Pro Max rear displays can run Google Maps, YouTube Music, Spotify and custom GenAI apps

why.bm: Menunjukkan usaha Xiaomi menjadikan skrin kedua berguna pada model global.
why.en: Shows Xiaomi's push to make secondary screens useful on global models.

summary.bm: Tajuk berita menyebut ia membaiki hampir 180 kelemahan (tajuk sahaja; halaman tidak dibuka).
summary.en: Headlines say it fixes almost 180 vulnerabilities (headline only; page not opened).

title.bm: Samsung lancar tampalan keselamatan November untuk Galaxy S26 dan Z Fold 8
title.en: Samsung rolls out November security patch to Galaxy S26 and Z Fold 8

why.bm: Pasang kemas kini pada telefon Galaxy anda.
why.en: Install the update on your Galaxy phone.

summary.bm: Ia meliputi Pixel 6a hingga Pixel 11 Pro Fold dengan 33 pembaikan Pixel; tahap tampalan 2026-11-01 dan 2026-11-05 disertakan.
summary.en: It covers Pixel 6a through Pixel 11 Pro Fold with 33 Pixel fixes; patch levels 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-05 are included.

title.bm: Android 17 QPR2 dikeluarkan awal bersama Feature Drop dan tampalan keselamatan Pixel November
title.en: Android 17 QPR2 ships early with November Pixel Feature Drop and security patch

why.bm: Kemas kini melalui Settings > System > System update.
why.en: Update via Settings > System > System update.

summary.bm: The Star melaporkan Washington bertindak menyekat akses jauh kepada cip AI termaju melalui negara ketiga. Nvidia juga menolak kepulangan Jensen Huang ketika kempen menuntut beliau kembali membesar, menjelang laporan pendapatan.
summary.en: The Star reports Washington is moving to restrict remote access to advanced AI chips through third countries. Nvidia also ruled out a comeback by Jensen Huang as a campaign for his return grows, ahead of its earnings.

title.bm: AS bertindak menyekat akses jauh kepada cip AI termaju melalui negara ketiga
title.en: US moves to restrict remote access to advanced AI chips via third countries

why.bm: Boleh menjejaskan akses awan dan pusat data untuk beban kerja AI yang dihoskan di Malaysia.
why.en: Could affect cloud and data centre access for Malaysia-hosted AI workloads.

summary.bm: Hasil naik 103% tahun ke tahun, dengan hasil pusat data $107.6 bilion dan tambahan belian semula saham $150 bilion; panduan suku keempat tidak mengambil kira jualan pengiraan pusat data ke China. Saham Nvidia dilaporkan jatuh kira-kira 28% sebulan, dan lembaga tidak berhasrat mengembalikan Jensen Huang sebagai CEO.
summary.en: Revenue rose 103% year on year, with data centre revenue of $107.6bn and a $150bn buyback increase; Q4 guidance assumes no China data-centre compute sales. Nvidia stock is reported down about 28% in a month, and the board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.

title.bm: Nvidia catat hasil suku ketiga sekitar $115.8 bilion, unjur suku keempat sekitar $130 bilion, Kress CEO sementara
title.en: Nvidia posts Q3 revenue of about $115.8bn, guides Q4 to about $130bn, with Kress as interim CEO

why.bm: Menentukan nada permintaan cip AI yang mempengaruhi pusat data dan sektor semikonduktor Malaysia.
why.en: Sets the tone for AI-chip demand that drives Malaysian data-centre and semiconductor plans.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan projek kabel dasar laut bernilai RM2.7 bilion itu diluluskan. Ia akan menghubungkan Semenanjung Malaysia dengan Sabah dan Sarawak.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports the RM2.7 billion submarine cable project has been approved. It would link Peninsular Malaysia with Sabah and Sarawak.

title.bm: TM Tech dapat lampu hijau projek kabel dasar laut RM2.7b menghubungkan Semenanjung, Sabah dan Sarawak
title.en: TM Tech gets green light for RM2.7b submarine cable linking Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah and Sarawak

why.bm: Sambungan lebih baik untuk Malaysia Timur serta pertumbuhan pusat data dan digital.
why.en: Better connectivity for East Malaysia and for data-centre and digital growth.

summary.bm: Bernama melaporkan industri pusat data Malaysia secara menyeluruh kurang terdedah kepada sekatan cip AI. Butiran penilaian terdapat dalam laporan Bernama.
summary.en: Bernama reports Malaysia's data centre industry overall is less exposed to AI chip restrictions. Details of the assessment are in the Bernama report.

title.bm: Industri pusat data Malaysia kurang terdedah kepada sekatan cip AI
title.en: Malaysia's data centre industry seen as less exposed to AI chip curbs

why.bm: Relevan kepada ledakan pusat data Johor dan pekerjaan IT tempatan.
why.en: Relevant to Johor's data centre boom and local IT jobs.

summary.bm: Bertitah pada konvokesyen ke-70 UTM, baginda menggesa penilaian terhadap permintaan elektrik dan air pusat data, penyalahgunaan tanah serta kesan bunyi dan pencahayaan, dan berkata AI patut meningkatkan kualiti hidup rakyat.
summary.en: Speaking at UTM's 70th convocation, she urged assessing data centres' electricity and water demand, land misuse, and noise and lighting effects, and said AI should improve people's quality of life.

title.bm: Raja Zarith Sofiah gesa kajian semula kesan pusat data terhadap komuniti Johor
title.en: Queen Raja Zarith Sofiah urges review of data centres' impact on Johor communities

why.bm: Menambah bobot kepada perdebatan mengenai pertumbuhan pusat data dan penggunaan sumber di Johor.
why.en: Adds weight to the debate over data centre growth and resource use in Johor.

summary.bm: Ujian perintis ini ialah latihan simulasi di kawasan berisiko banjir di Selangor, Kuala Lumpur, Kelantan dan Pahang. Ia tidak memerlukan nombor telefon, data atau aplikasi dan berfungsi ketika panggilan sesak.
summary.en: The pilot is a simulated drill in flood-prone areas of Selangor, Kuala Lumpur, Kelantan and Pahang. It needs no phone number, data or app and works when calls are congested.

title.bm: MCMC uji perintis Sistem Siaran Sel amaran bencana pada 19 Nov
title.en: MCMC to pilot Cell Broadcast System disaster alert on 19 Nov

why.bm: Jangkakan amaran ujian; ia bukan kecemasan sebenar.
why.en: Expect a test alert; it is not a real emergency.

summary.bm: Air banjir merendam jalan menuju Plaza Tol Kemuning pada 17 Nov, menurut video Malay Mail.
summary.en: Floodwaters covered the road leading to Kemuning Toll Plaza on 17 Nov, as shown in a Malay Mail video.

title.bm: Air banjir rendam jalan ke Plaza Tol Kemuning
title.en: Floodwaters swamp road to Kemuning Toll Plaza

why.bm: Semak maklumat trafik sebelum bergerak di Selangor.
why.en: Check traffic updates before travelling in Selangor.

summary.bm: 16 penghuni itu berumur 65 hingga 85 tahun. Malay Mail melaporkan operasi menyelamat itu pada 17 Nov.
summary.en: The 16 residents were aged 65 to 85. Malay Mail reported the rescue on 17 Nov.

title.bm: Bomba selamatkan 16 warga emas selepas banjir kilat landa rumah penjagaan di Kluang
title.en: Firemen rescue 16 elderly people after flash floods hit Kluang nursing home

why.bm: Banjir kilat terus melanda Johor.
why.en: Flash floods continue to hit Johor.

summary.bm: Jawatankuasa Kira-kira Wang Negara (PAC) menggesa kerajaan menamatkan monopoli konsesi bekalan kenderaan. Gesaan itu dilaporkan Malay Mail pada 18 Nov.
summary.en: The Public Accounts Committee has called on the government to end the monopoly on vehicle supply concessions. The call was reported by Malay Mail on 18 Nov.

title.bm: PAC gesa kerajaan putuskan monopoli konsesi bekalan kenderaan
title.en: PAC urges govt to break monopoly on vehicle supply concessions

why.bm: Monopoli konsesi boleh menjejaskan kos dan persaingan untuk pengguna jalan raya dan wang awam.
why.en: Concession monopolies can affect costs and competition for road users and the public purse.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan kes itu pada 17 Nov. Penipu menyamar sebagai polis melalui telefon.
summary.en: Malay Mail reported the case on 17 Nov. Scammers impersonated police over the phone.

title.bm: Dua wanita rugi RM1.18 juta kepada penipu telefon yang menyamar polis
title.en: Two women lose RM1.18m to phone scammers posing as police

why.bm: Polis tidak pernah meminta anda memindahkan wang; hubungi NSRC 997.
why.en: Police never ask you to transfer money; call NSRC 997.

summary.bm: Laporan PAC mendedahkan Malaysia Airports berunding dengan AirAsia berhubung bayaran hutang kira-kira RM500 juta.
summary.en: A PAC report reveals Malaysia Airports is in talks with AirAsia on repaying about RM500 million in debt.

title.bm: MAHB berunding dengan AirAsia mengenai pelan bayaran hutang RM500j
title.en: MAHB in talks with AirAsia over RM500m debt repayment plan

why.bm: Menjejaskan kewangan lapangan terbang dan operasi syarikat penerbangan.
why.en: Affects airport finances and airline operations.

summary.bm: Kementerian Dalam Negeri berkata kerugian akibat penipuan dalam talian berjumlah RM6.95 bilion sejak 2023. Polis meneruskan tindakan terhadap sindiket penipuan.
summary.en: The Home Ministry said losses to online scams total RM6.95 billion since 2023. Police continue crackdowns on scam syndicates.

title.bm: Rakyat Malaysia rugi RM6.95 bilion akibat penipuan dalam talian sejak 2023, kata KDN
title.en: Malaysians lost RM6.95b to online scams since 2023, Home Ministry says

why.bm: Sahkan panggilan dan pautan tidak dikenali; lapor melalui NSRC 997.
why.en: Verify unknown calls and links; report via NSRC 997.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan BNM berkata bank meningkatkan perbelanjaan keselamatan siber selepas serangan baru-baru ini.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports BNM says banks are raising cybersecurity spending after recent attacks.

title.bm: Bank Malaysia tingkat pelaburan keselamatan siber selepas serangan baru-baru ini, kata BNM
title.en: Malaysian banks step up cybersecurity investment after recent attacks, says BNM

why.bm: Berkaitan keselamatan akaun bank anda.
why.en: Relevant to the safety of your bank accounts.

summary.bm: Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil memaklumkan Dewan Rakyat platform mempunyai sehingga akhir 2026 untuk menyediakan tindakan automatik terhadap kandungan berbahaya di bawah kod Akta Keselamatan Dalam Talian 2025, dengan denda RM1 juta hingga RM10 juta setiap kesalahan. Mesyuarat tiga negara dijangka pada pertengahan Disember.
summary.en: Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil told Parliament platforms have until end-2026 to set up automatic action on harmful content under the Online Safety Act 2025 code, with fines of RM1 million to RM10 million per offence. A three-country meeting is expected in mid-December.
